description: Write off hours from an approved time report, removing them from the billable pool without invoicing (e.g. discounts or goodwill). Requires Finance role or above.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

hours.description: Number of hours to write off (required, must be > 0 and ≤ remaining billable hours).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

time_report_id.description: ID of the approved time report to write off hours from (required).

name: write_off_time
